notes.title: New maps and skills - Progress report
notes.content:
The development is in full swing! Meanwhile, there are 2 new explorable areas in the game and improvements on the battle mechanisms. 

[h2]New maps[/h2]
Since the last update, there are 2 more explorable areas, among the 7 areas that are planned. Players not only will do main quests, but also the side missions that appear along with the progress of the game. Here's some sneak peek! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40062945/463cf1d233ad4a273b83fc9e0106bee5077ecfee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40062945/993c70923f180eb2c9a80a64430c749d48e3d615.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle mechanics[/h2]
[h3]New skills[/h3]
Thunder skills are not only cool, but they can also stun fouls! Later in the game, players can create their own combo skills to suit their unique play style. Combo skills will be activated if the player pressed the button at the right timing. It will make the casting more rapid and cost less mana. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40062945/3846fe0c4b3cf373ff08efedb4599f250c6bda20.gif[/img]

[h3]Dodge and recovery[/h3]
Before the enemy's attack, players can dodge to greatly minimize the influence of the attack. If the attack is heavy, the player will be knocked back. Pressing the recovery button before landing will ignore the recovery time and increase the moving speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40062945/360e8a327a60c23516cd4f2a43c7afaccd2978c9.gif[/img]
